assets.prompt: Edit the attached original SADI WALK animation sheet into a SABRE action sheet. The attached image is the actual in-game character, not loose style inspiration. PRESERVE HIS ORIGINAL HEAD DESIGN AS EXACTLY AS POSSIBLE in each corresponding direction: same pixelated dark eyes and small eye whites, relaxed eyebrows, original round cheek contour, nose, short full beard shape, the exact hair silhouette and the chunky stepped pixel texture. Treat the heads as locked cutouts from the supplied sheet: do not beautify, sharpen the jaw, enlarge eyes, draw a pointed beard, add highlights or give him a new expression. Keep the very same muted pixel-art finish, top-down 30-degree RPG camera and adult body proportions. The prior attempt looked like a different smooth cartoon man; absolutely avoid smooth comic outlines, anime eyes, polished 3D shading or a new face. Keep the SAME cream shirt and plain cream apron with pocket, red neckerchief, suspenders, dark bombacha and brown boots. Preserve body height, shoulder width and head-to-body ratio of the reference. Change only the arm poses, a subtle stance weight shift, and the held tool. Output exactly 12 complete isolated sprites, 4 columns x 3 rows, transparent alpha with no scenery or shadows. Row 1: front/down, using the EXACT front heads from input row 1; row 2: right-facing true profile, using the EXACT heads from input row 2; row 3: back/up, original rear heads. Each row has four phases of wielding a gently curved silver naval sabre with a small metal D guard in his anatomical RIGHT hand: column 1 guard, blade diagonal before torso with tip below the head; column 2 wind-up beside shoulder, column 3 forward sweeping slash, column 4 low follow-through. Keep front heads facing straight forward, no 3/4 head turns. All heads keep the original neutral face and original pixel clusters. Natural arms and slightly braced legs, not squat/wide chibi anatomy. Fixed body scale and feet baseline, no feet or blade clipped, plenty of transparent space around every frame. No loops, guns, flashes, motion streaks, lettering or extra objects. This is the original supplied Sadi with a sword, NOT a reimagining of him.

Edit the attached original SADI WALK animation sheet into a LASSO action sheet. Preserve the original character's FACE AND HEAD AS EXACTLY AS POSSIBLE: use matching original front/profile/rear heads from the reference like locked pixel cutouts. The same small dark pixel eyes, minimal eye whites, soft eyebrow shape, round cheek and short full beard, hairline and dark-brown wavy hair silhouette with stepped pixel shading. Do not redesign or beautify the face, sharpen his chin, give huge cartoon eyes, enlarge the head, or smooth the pixel edges. Keep original neutral facial expression, original 30-degree overhead game perspective, original body proportions, muted pixel palette and grain. The previous attempt looked like a different smooth illustration: here preserve the ACTUAL supplied character, especially his exact head. Same cream rolled-sleeve shirt, plain cream apron with pocket, suspenders, red scarf, charcoal bombacha trousers and brown boots. Change only arm and modest torso poses needed for lassoing, with both feet near their original stance. 12 isolated full-body sprites arranged four columns and three rows on a truly transparent canvas. Row1 front/down, row2 true profile facing RIGHT, row3 back/up. Use reference's corresponding row heads without extra rotations. Columns: (1) anatomical right hand raised beside the right ear beginning a rope swing, (2) right hand above/a little ahead of forehead during spin, (3) right arm reaches forward/open hand to release rope toward facing direction, (4) right hand comes back near chest pulling rope. Left hand always holds a small spare tan rope coil at left hip. NO overhead rope loop or flying rope strand in the drawing, as the game renders it separately. Same fixed head/body scale across all frames, feet on shared baseline for each row, generous transparent gutters, complete hair and boot silhouettes. Do not copy the original walking steps, give a steady planted stance with slight weight shift. Keep each hand clearly readable and separate from face. No background glow, shadows, labels, text, grid or other props. Preserve the exact original Sadi identity in every frame.

note: Revisão v2 feita diretamente sobre a folha original de caminhada. As versões v1 não são mais carregadas pelo jogo.
